title: Add numeric clamp helper
goal: Add a clamp(value, min, max) helper to the math module without changing existing add/subtract behavior.
doneCriteria: Inspect the current math module
clamp() is exported and bounds values inclusively

setupFiles.src/math.js:
export function add(a, b) { return a + b; }
export function subtract(a, b) { return a - b; }

title: Add unique array helper
goal: Add a unique(values) helper that removes duplicates while preserving first-seen order.
doneCriteria: Inspect the current array helpers
unique() is exported, removes duplicates, and preserves first-seen order

args.content:
export function first(values) { return values[0]; }
export function unique(values) { return [...new Set(values)]; }
